items.mainDefect: The safe_urlopen call to GitHub's OAuth token endpoint runs outside the try/except, so a connection error or timeout raises an unhandled exception and returns a 500 instead of the graceful failure page.

secondary.defect: get_user_info(payload["access_token"]) is not wrapped in try/except, so an API error from GitHub escapes and returns a 500 instead of the error page.
